description: This file defines a set of React components for a UI sheet/modal, utilizing Radix UI primitives and custom styling utilities. It includes components for the sheet container, trigger, close button, overlay, content, header, footer, title, and description, with configurable sides and styling.

methods.name: Sheet
methods.description: Main component wrapping Radix UI Root for the sheet modal.

methods.name: SheetTrigger
methods.description: Component to trigger opening the sheet.

methods.name: SheetPortal
methods.description: Component rendering the sheet in a portal.

methods.name: SheetOverlay
methods.description: Overlay component with styling and animation.

methods.name: SheetContent
methods.description: Main content container for the sheet, with configurable side.
